# cloptima_llm_gateway_policy (Resource)

A Cloptima managed LLM gateway governance policy: model/provider allow-deny lists, rate limits, budgets, exact/semantic cache, and guardrail configuration. Approval-gated changes may remain at their current effective values pending human review unless apply_immediately is set and the applying identity has the required role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy display name, unique per customer (case-insensitive).

### Optional

- `allowed_modalities` (List of String) Allowed request/response modalities.
- `allowed_models` (List of String) Allowed canonical model IDs/patterns. Empty means no model restriction.
- `allowed_providers` (List of String) Allowed provider names. Empty means no provider restriction.
- `allowed_tool_names` (List of String) Allowed MCP tool names.
- `allowed_tool_servers` (List of String) Allowed registered tool server names (see cloptima_llm_gateway_tool_server).
- `apply_immediately` (Boolean) When true and the applying identity has the required role, an approval-gated change is approved and takes effect in the same apply. Otherwise, the change follows the standard approval flow. Defaults to false when omitted.
- `budget_mode` (String) Budget enforcement mode: observe, soft, hard_fast, or hard_strict.
- `daily_budget_usd` (Number) Daily spend ceiling in USD.
- `default_credential_id` (String) Default BYOK provider credential ID used when a request does not specify one.
- `default_credential_ids` (String) Per-provider default credential IDs as a JSON object, e.g. {"openai": "cred-id"}.
- `denied_models` (List of String) Denied canonical model IDs/patterns; deny wins over allow.
- `denied_tool_names` (List of String) Denied MCP tool names; deny wins over allow.
- `denied_tool_servers` (List of String) Denied registered tool server names; deny wins over allow.
- `embedding_credential_id` (String) BYOK provider credential ID used for generating semantic cache embeddings; required when embedding_credential_mode is cloud_byok or edge_local_byok, and must be empty for managed_credits.
- `embedding_credential_mode` (String) Credential mode for semantic cache embeddings: managed_credits (Cloptima-funded), cloud_byok, or edge_local_byok.
- `exact_cache_allowed_content_classes` (List of String) Content classes eligible for exact caching.
- `exact_cache_allowed_models` (List of String) Models eligible for exact caching.
- `exact_cache_compression_enabled` (Boolean) Enable compression of cached payloads.
- `exact_cache_compression_threshold_bytes` (Number) Payload size above which compression applies.
- `exact_cache_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the exact response cache.
- `exact_cache_key_scope` (List of String) Dimensions included in the exact cache key.
- `exact_cache_lookup_timeout_ms` (Number) Exact cache lookup timeout in milliseconds.
- `exact_cache_max_payload_bytes` (Number) Maximum cached payload size in bytes.
- `exact_cache_mode` (String) Exact cache mode: off, observe, or enforce.
- `exact_cache_sensitive_data_action` (String) Action when sensitive data is detected in a cacheable request.
- `exact_cache_streaming_action` (String) Action for streaming responses under exact caching.
- `exact_cache_ttl_seconds` (Number) Exact cache entry TTL in seconds.
- `fail_mode` (String) Policy enforcement behavior when a required service is unavailable: fail_open or fail_closed.
- `guardrail_bypass_allowed_content_classes` (List of String) Content classes eligible for guardrail bypass.
- `guardrail_bypass_max_policy_age_seconds` (Number) Maximum policy age eligible for guardrail bypass.
- `guardrail_bypass_requires_cache_key_match` (Boolean) Require an exact cache-key match for guardrail bypass eligibility.
- `guardrail_bypass_requires_guardrail_profile_version_match` (Boolean) Require a matching guardrail profile version for bypass eligibility.
- `guardrail_cache_hit_bypass_enabled` (Boolean) Allow cache hits to bypass guardrail scanning.
- `guardrail_cost_exceeded_action` (String) Action when guardrail cost ceilings are exceeded: downgrade, require_approval, or block.
- `guardrail_cost_mode` (String) Guardrail cost-gating mode: off, observe, or enforce.
- `guardrail_detector_severity_threshold` (String) Per-detector severity thresholds as a JSON object.
- `guardrail_detectors_enabled` (List of String) Enabled guardrail detector categories: prompt_injection, jailbreak, toxicity, pii, secret, custom.
- `guardrail_evidence_retention_days` (Number) Days to retain guardrail evidence.
- `guardrail_lightweight_profile_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the lightweight guardrail fallback profile.
- `guardrail_max_cost_pct_of_execution` (Number) Maximum guardrail scan cost as a percentage of execution cost.
- `guardrail_max_cost_per_request_cents` (Number) Maximum guardrail scan cost per request, in cents.
- `guardrail_output_action` (String) Action on guardrail output violation: observe, redact, or block.
- `guardrail_preverified_app_bypass_enabled` (Boolean) Allow preverified apps to bypass guardrail scanning.
- `guardrail_provider_integration` (String) Guardrail provider integration config as JSON: {kind: "webhook"|"bedrock_guardrails"|"azure_content_safety", ...}.
- `guardrail_provider_max_elapsed_ms_before_skip` (Number) Latency budget before a provider guardrail scan is skipped.
- `guardrail_required_risk_tier` (String) Minimum risk tier required before heavy guardrail scanning applies.
- `max_input_tokens` (Number) Ceiling on input tokens per request.
- `max_loop_iterations` (Number) Ceiling on agent loop iterations.
- `max_output_images` (Number) Ceiling on output images per request.
- `max_output_tokens` (Number) Ceiling on output tokens per request.
- `max_retry_count` (Number) Ceiling on upstream retries per request.
- `max_tool_calls` (Number) Ceiling on tool calls per request.
- `max_video_duration_seconds` (Number) Ceiling on output video duration in seconds.
- `metadata` (String) Optional JSON metadata for customer-defined labels and context. Configure routing through this resource's routing_* and routing_adaptive_* attributes.
- `mode` (String) Enforcement mode: observe or enforce.
- `monthly_budget_usd` (Number) Monthly spend ceiling in USD.
- `prompt_retention_mode` (String) Prompt/response retention mode for audit logging: none, metadata_only, tool_io, or full.
- `request_rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Requests-per-minute ceiling.
- `routing_adaptive_approved_eval_id` (String) Eval run ID approving this candidate set for canary/enforce mode. Required in canary/enforce mode.
- `routing_adaptive_approved_release_gate_id` (String) Release gate ID approving this candidate set for canary/enforce mode. Required in canary/enforce mode.
- `routing_adaptive_canary_basis_points` (Number) Traffic percentage (in basis points, 0-10000) substituted under canary mode. Only used when routing_adaptive_mode = "canary".
- `routing_adaptive_candidate_models_balanced` (List of String) Canonical model IDs eligible as "balanced" tier substitution candidates, up to 10.
- `routing_adaptive_candidate_models_cheap` (List of String) Canonical model IDs eligible as "cheap" tier substitution candidates, up to 10.
- `routing_adaptive_candidate_models_strong` (List of String) Canonical model IDs eligible as "strong" tier substitution candidates, up to 10.
- `routing_adaptive_candidate_set_version` (String) Version label for this policy's candidate model set, for audit and rollback tracking.
- `routing_adaptive_enabled` (Boolean) Enable adaptive routing (workload-tier model substitution) for this policy.
- `routing_adaptive_medium_risk_approved` (Boolean) Explicit confirmation required alongside routing_adaptive_risk_ceiling = "medium" in canary/enforce mode.
- `routing_adaptive_mode` (String) Adaptive routing mode: off, observe, canary, or enforce. Only meaningful when routing_adaptive_enabled is true.
- `routing_adaptive_risk_ceiling` (String) Maximum acceptable substitution risk tier: low, medium, or high. medium in canary/enforce mode additionally requires routing_adaptive_medium_risk_approved.
- `routing_adaptive_rollback_cooldown_minutes` (Number) Cooldown in minutes after a rollback before re-evaluation resumes, 5-1440. Required in canary/enforce mode; defaults to 30 there.
- `routing_adaptive_rollback_evaluation_window_minutes` (Number) Rollback evaluation window in minutes, 5-1440. Required in canary/enforce mode; defaults to 30 there.
- `routing_adaptive_rollback_max_error_rate` (Number) Automatic-rollback error-rate threshold, 0-1. Required in canary/enforce mode; defaults to 0.1 there.
- `routing_adaptive_rollback_max_fallback_rate` (Number) Automatic-rollback fallback-rate threshold, 0-1. Required in canary/enforce mode; defaults to 0.2 there.
- `routing_adaptive_rollback_min_sample_size` (Number) Minimum sample size before rollback signals are evaluated, 10-10000. Required in canary/enforce mode; defaults to 50 there.
- `routing_backoff` (String) Backoff strategy between retries on the same route: none or exponential_jitter.
- `routing_backoff_initial_ms` (Number) Initial backoff delay in milliseconds.
- `routing_backoff_max_ms` (Number) Maximum backoff delay in milliseconds, up to 5000.
- `routing_cost_ceiling_usd` (Number) Per-request cost ceiling in USD considered when ranking fallback routes under a cost-aware load_balancing_mode.
- `routing_fallback_conditions` (List of String) Failure classes that trigger moving to the next fallback route: route_exhausted, rate_limit, provider_unavailable, authentication, quota, model_unavailable.
- `routing_fallback_routes` (List of String) Ordered fallback routes as "provider/model" strings, tried in order after the request's own primary route. Setting this (or a max_attempts/max_total_attempts above 1) is what activates resiliency for this policy.
- `routing_first_output_timeout_ms` (Number) Per-attempt first-output deadline in milliseconds, up to 60000.
- `routing_load_balancing_mode` (String) Objective used to rank fallback routes when more than one is eligible: reliability, latency, cost, throughput, region, capability, or weighted. The already-dispatched primary route is never reordered - this only orders explicit fallbacks.
- `routing_max_attempts_per_route` (Number) Maximum attempts on a single route before moving to fallback, 1-4.
- `routing_max_fallback_attempts` (Number) Maximum number of fallback routes to try, on top of the primary route.
- `routing_max_total_attempts` (Number) Maximum attempts across every route combined for one logical request, 1-8.
- `routing_request_timeout_ms` (Number) Total logical-request deadline in milliseconds across every attempt, up to 120000.
- `routing_retryable_classes` (List of String) Failure classes retried within a route before moving on: connect, timeout_before_output, rate_limit, provider_5xx, authentication, quota.
- `semantic_cache_allowed_apps` (List of String) Apps eligible for semantic caching.
- `semantic_cache_allowed_content_classes` (List of String) Content classes eligible for semantic caching.
- `semantic_cache_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the semantic response cache.
- `semantic_cache_max_age_seconds` (Number) Maximum age of a semantic cache entry in seconds.
- `semantic_cache_mode` (String) Semantic cache mode: off, observe, suggest, or enforce. Enforce mode may remain in suggest mode until required approval is complete; check approval status in the Cloptima console.
- `semantic_cache_required_eval_score` (Number) Minimum offline eval score required before a semantic entry is servable.
- `semantic_cache_review_required` (Boolean) Require human review before a semantic cache entry becomes servable.
- `semantic_cache_similarity_threshold` (Number) Minimum similarity score for a semantic cache hit.
- `semantic_cache_source_freshness_policy` (String) Freshness policy applied to the semantic cache source entry.
- `token_rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Tokens-per-minute ceiling.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `exact_cache_allowed_routes` (List of String) Routes eligible for exact caching. Determined by Cloptima and not directly configurable.
- `id` (String) Policy ID.
- `semantic_cache_allowed_routes` (List of String) Routes eligible for semantic caching. Determined by Cloptima and not directly configurable.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
